summary:
Already fixed in the Debian trixie qemu source; no Echo patch required.
Upstream 9b899ddb2706150ee1e5d0150a11bb021377ecb8 ("hw/ide/core: Fix
possible crash via NULL pointer in ide_cancel_dma_sync()") came in with
the 10.0.13 stable release and is listed in the 1:10.0.13+ds-0+deb13u1
debian/changelog. hw/ide/core.c in that source already drains both
drives' blk only when non-NULL, so the vulnerable blk_drain(s->blk) call
is not in the released code. The Debian tracker still lists trixie as
postponed.
https://gitlab.com/qemu-project/qemu/-/commit/9b899ddb2706150ee1e5d0150a11bb021377ecb8
https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2020-25743
